review_scope: All stored-password test declarations including six malformed digest variants

declarations.parity_review: Preserves normalized uppercase/whitespace username and correct Unicode password yielding id owner; wrong and absent-user credentials each return exactly null. Manual comparison preserves every input, parameterized variant and predicate. Rust owns credentials and all sixteen null/id assertions in passwords.json. The test-only passwords.ts driver evaluates exactly the original salt/scrypt fixture and digest transformations, opens/migrates a new :memory: database per call, inserts owner/alice with original now timestamps, updates only the same stored hash, and invokes production UserService.verifyCredentials. Full observations retain a required value property, so undefined cannot collapse into the null required by toBeNull. Console suppression matches the original fixture spy and restores in finally; SQLite closes in finally. There are no module mocks or real credentials. All eight original Vitest cases and all 399 internal contracts pass, with report sources unchanged. Required Rust vector IDs reject removed/duplicated registrations. This is reference test equivalence, not Rust gateway password implementation parity.
